purpose: Bind ERP + PLM + MES + BPM + QMS + MBSE + Knowledge Graph + Agent Runtime projection concepts to existing OLEANDER authority, runtime layers and operational planes without creating a parallel system of record.

modules.intent: portfolio/project/work demand, schedule and resource-demand projection
modules.hard_boundary: ERP demand/schedule/resource visibility does not own project authority, budget truth, professional status or promotion.

modules.intent: configuration item, baseline, revision, supersession and change-impact projection
modules.hard_boundary: PLM release/baseline means configuration identity only; it does not prove technical correctness, Design KEEP, approval or promotion.

modules.intent: native/physical operation execution and actual readback projection inspired by enterprise-control separation
modules.hard_boundary: MES COMPLETE is forbidden without actual readback; digital execution does not imply physical fabrication/installation/field truth.

modules.intent: process-instance, handoff, waiting/blocker and exception projection
modules.hard_boundary: BPM process completion never substitutes for professional stage closure, independent review or promotion.

modules.intent: quality plan, nonconformance, CAPA, inspection/review and effectiveness readback projection
modules.hard_boundary: Quality disposition and CAPA closure require source evidence/effectiveness readback and do not award professional/statutory approval.

modules.intent: requirements, system elements, interfaces, allocation, verification/validation and configuration-baseline projection
canonical_owners: Systems Engineering Candidate when only in bounded evaluation
modules.hard_boundary: MBSE is a traceability/model projection; verification does not imply validation, Systems Engineering Current authority or project acceptance.

modules.intent: typed reference/provenance/query projection over canonical Knowledge and project/runtime entities
modules.hard_boundary: A graph edge, similarity or query result never creates Canonical Parent, Current, OE3, claim truth or authority.

modules.intent: agent session, lease, action, tool use, handoff, side-effect and readback projection
modules.hard_boundary: Agent success or tool success grants no authority; uncertain side effects force HOLD/reconciliation.

cross_module_invariants.rule: Every cross-module relation carries source_refs and remains projection_only.
No module may synthesize an authority-bearing canonical ID from another module identity.
PLM RELEASED + MES COMPLETE + BPM COMPLETED + QMS PASS may still coexist with Design REVISE / Professional HOLD / No Promotion.
MBSE verification and validation are distinct records and cannot be collapsed.
Knowledge Graph provenance may describe lineage but cannot create lifecycle or decision authority.
Agent Runtime side-effect uncertainty is a reconciliation blocker; retry may not silently duplicate mutations.
No cross-module two-phase commit or distributed transaction manager is introduced; partial effects use explicit reconciliation/compensation under existing owners.
